A '''Spell of Lighting''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It was extremely similar to [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], and allowed a witch to summon bolts of energy from her hand that caused extreme pain and physical damage to people hit by them.<ref name="CTD" />
